# EB5 Base - llms.txt
# https://eb5base.com

> Investor-built information tools for the EB-5 community. Not legal or financial advice. Not affiliated with USCIS or DHS.

## Primary tools

- [NPRM Comment Guide](https://eb5base.com/nprm): Plain-English explainer of the July 2 2026 EB-5 NPRM (USCIS-2026-0100), impact matrix, themes, and comment builder. Comments due Aug 31 2026.
- [NPRM Summary](https://eb5base.com/nprm/summary): Section-by-section Current / Proposed / Impact notes with Federal Register citations.
- [Comment builder](https://eb5base.com/nprm/write): Personalize a draft for regulations.gov (user submits manually).
- [Status Update](https://eb5base.com/status): Structured EB-5 status message builder for community sharing.
- [Case Tracker](https://eb5base.com/tracker): Coming soon. USCIS case tracking with privacy-first design.

## Official sources

- Federal Register HTML: https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2026-13392
- Federal Register PDF: https://www.govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2026-07-02/pdf/2026-13392.pdf
- Docket: https://www.regulations.gov/docket/USCIS-2026-0100
- Comment form: https://www.regulations.gov/commenton/USCIS-2026-0100-0001
